mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over the past month (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 0.5% in a single month, it signals an imminent tightening cycle that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both the unemployment rate and payroll growth signals a tightening labor market that accelerates inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE declines and PAYEMS declines (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high consumer credit growth, a decline in residential mortgage credit (RSAFS) signals a cooling housing market that reduces consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS declines during high consumer credit growth (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past month indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO declines (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1000.0 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing market that reduces consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST is below 1000.0 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Following a Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting where the federal funds rate is raised (indicated by an increase in FEDFUNDS from the prior month), a subsequent decline in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals that the rate hike has successfully cooled inflation without causing a recession, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS increased from prior month and CPIAUCSL declines (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 5.0%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).
